title: 第1章 老虎会爬树第2章 你要分手
slug: 我能穿越去修仙你跟我分手
content_zh:
【左脑寄存处！】
本书已改编为番茄同名【漫剧】，看过漫剧的朋友，请从第49章开始看，剧情无缝衔接。
……
‘这是哪里？’
林渊猛地睁眼。
一片从未见过的原始密林撞入视野。
参天巨木的树冠将天空割裂成碎片。
潮湿腐败的气息混杂着泥土的腥味，蛮横地钻入鼻腔。
四周死寂，连一声虫鸣都听不到。
仿佛连空气都被凝固了。
前一秒，他明明还在自己那间不足十平米的出租屋里。
可现在……
他低头看向胸口。
那枚地摊上淘来的玉佩，此刻正贴着皮肤，触感冰凉。
原本温润的色泽也变得通体灰暗，仿佛所有生机都被抽干。
‘一定是它搞的鬼！’
记忆的碎片在脑中炸开。
不久前，母亲在电话里压抑的哭声，字字如锤，让他心如刀绞。
“渊儿，你爸……查出来是癌症。”
“医生说，需要尽快手术。”

“手术费至少要三十万。”
三十万。
对于一个刚刚大学毕业一年的社畜，一个妹妹还在读高三的家庭，这是一个足以压垮一切的数字。
更像是一座沉重的大山，瞬间压在了他稚嫩的肩膀上。
他什么也做不了。
当时唯一的念头就是回家。
他甚至给女友姜瑶打了个电话。
不是借钱，只是想告知一声，寻求一丝慰藉。
电话那头，姜瑶的声音听不出什么波澜，只是公式化地安慰道：
“你放心，叔叔一定会好起来的。”
这句敷衍的安慰，在当时却是他唯一的慰藉。
他冲出家门，跨上二手电动车，准备去火车站。
不料半路遭遇暴雨，他连人带车摔在泥水里。
他狼狈地拐回出租屋，才发现出门时忘了关窗。
雨水倒灌，打湿了插线板，导致全屋跳闸。
黑暗中，唯有书桌上的玉佩，正散发着诡异的血色红光，仿佛一只嗜血的眼睛。
他伸出手想要拿起。
却没发现，指节上蹭破的伤口，一滴鲜血恰好滴落在玉佩表面。
恰在此时，玉佩上红光暴涨，刺的他眼睛都睁不开。
那红光，瞬间将他吞噬。
content_en:
【Left brain storage place! 】
This book has been adapted into a comic series of the same name by Tomato. Friends who have read the comic series, please start reading from Chapter 49. The plot is seamlessly connected.
…
‘Where is this? ’
Lin Yuan opened his eyes suddenly.
A virgin forest that had never been seen before came into view.
The canopies of towering trees split the sky into fragments.
The smell of dampness and decay mixed with the fishy smell of earth penetrated the nose arbitrarily.
It was completely silent, not even a sound of insects could be heard.
It was as if even the air was frozen.
One second ago, he was clearly still in his own rental house of less than ten square meters.
But now...
He looked down at his chest.
The jade pendant I found on the street stall was now close to my skin and felt cold to the touch.
The originally warm and moist color had also turned completely gray, as if all the vitality had been drained away.
‘It must be the fault! ’
Fragments of memory exploded in my mind.
Not long ago, his mother's suppressed cries on the phone, every word was like a hammer, made him feel like a knife.
"Yuan'er, your dad... was found to have cancer."
"The doctor said that surgery is needed as soon as possible."
"The operation fee will be at least three hundred thousand."
Three hundred thousand.
For a family with a social worker who has just graduated from college and a younger sister who is still in her senior year of high school, this is an overwhelming number.
It was more like a heavy mountain, instantly pressing on his young shoulders.
There was nothing he could do.
The only thought at that time was to go home.
He even called his girlfriend Jiang Yao.
I'm not borrowing money, I just want to let you know and seek some comfort.
On the other end of the phone, Jiang Yao's voice could not hear any waves, and she just comforted her in a formulaic way:
"Don't worry, uncle will get better."
This perfunctory comfort was his only comfort at the time.
He rushed out of the house, got on his second-hand electric car, and prepared to go to the train station.
Unexpectedly, there was a heavy rain on the way, and he and his car fell into the muddy water.
He turned back to the rental house in embarrassment, only to realize that he had forgotten to close the window when he went out.
Rainwater poured in and wet the power strip, causing the entire house to trip.
In the darkness, only the jade pendant on the desk was emitting a strange bloody red light, like a bloodthirsty eye.
He reached out to pick it up.
But he didn't notice that a drop of blood fell on the surface of the jade pendant from the scratch on his knuckles.
At this moment, the red light on the jade pendant surged, piercing him so much that he couldn't even open his eyes.
The red light swallowed him up instantly.
